recommendation: Keep the fix. A later publisher/tooling change could make [%dtusage *%] include active infrastructure datatypes automatically, but this source edit corrects the current implementer-visible omission without reintroducing obsolete StructureMap wording.
issue_request: FHIR-26935 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by MnM. It asked to change the datatypes open-type section from "open references" to "open types" and to update the usage list because ElementDefinition and Extension were missing from the R4-era list of Parameters, StructureMap, and Task.
initial_application: Commit d621ab0bda61832d87d16ee8fa98261bf403a9da applied the terminology part by changing source/datatypes.html from "Open references" to "Open types". The page still relied only on [%dtusage *%], and the Jira comment recorded uncertainty because Extension and StructureMap still appeared absent from the generated list.
additional_context: Current fhir.ini keeps source/datatypes.html in scope for wildcard "*" types and keeps Extension as an active infrastructure type on extensibility.html. Current source/datatypes/extension.xml still defines Extension.value[x] with type "*". Current StructureMap source now enumerates specific primitive types for StructureMap.group.rule.target.parameter.value[x], so StructureMap should not be re-added. The current CI build rendered the list with ElementDefinition, DosageCondition, Claim, ClaimResponse, ExplanationOfBenefit, Parameters, and Task, but not Extension.
reconciliation: Edited source/datatypes.html to explicitly include a link to Extension before the generated [%dtusage *%] list. No generated artifacts were edited.
source_changes: source/datatypes.html: prepended an explicit extensibility.html#Extension link to the open-type usage list before the generated [%dtusage *%] macro.
